build_ConvDecoder: build a ConvDecoder module to predict 1D-4D parameter tensors from node embeddings using convolutions
build_MLPDecoder: build an MLPDecoder module to predict 1D-4D parameter tensors from node embeddings using an MLP
run_ConvDecoder_forward: run the ConvDecoder forward pass with node embeddings and optional class prediction
run_MLPDecoder_forward: run the MLPDecoder forward pass with node embeddings and optional class prediction
review_ConvDecoder_class_prediction: review the ConvDecoder class_layer_predictor for class prediction on graph neural network outputs
